{{Quote|I'd like to say I've stayed in worse places, but...|Mara Jade|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
'''Takara's stronghold''' was a fortress used as [[Takara]]'s personal base for his [[Takara's organization|criminal organization]].

==Design==
{{Quote|Is this the best that Ka'Pa has to offer? Let's find our rat some suitable accommodations. I'm sure Takara will have some questions he'll want to ask her.|Abron Mar, to a [[Stun blaster/Legends|stunned]] Mara Jade|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
[[File:Takara Rancor MOTS.png|thumb|left|200px|Takara's rancor]]
Built directly out of a cliff side to the south and surrounded by water to the north, the stronghold used natural defenses. Inside, there were many rooms of varying design. One space featured a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Torture/Legends|torture]] facility with an adjoining smelting room, a private [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] dock, and, most notably, a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] pit.<ref name="MOTS" />

It also featured an extensive dungeon complex, containing fifteen cells, guarded by [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]]. The back wall of a cell collapsed, allowing anyone with access to the cell to escape into the sewer system. To do so was [[Death/Legends|deadly]], as the sewers led to [[Takara's rancor]].<ref name="MOTS" />

==History==
{{Quote|My rival Takara has stolen a valuable piece of surveillance equipment, which he uses to listen in on my operations.|translated=1|Ka'Pa, to Mara Jade to set terms for their trade deal in Huttese|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
[[File:GCT.jpg|thumb|rght|200px|The Global Communications Transponder stolen by Takara]]
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was imprisoned within [[Takara]]'s stronghold after falling into a trap laid in [[Katraasii Spaceport]] by [[Abron Mar]],<ref name="MOTS" /> Takara's right-had man.<ref name="Feat">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_features.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - Features}}</ref> After fighting through the dungeons with her bare hands, she killed Takara's rancor after retrieving her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], stole back a valuable [[Global Communications Transponder|device]], and successfully escaped to return the device back to [[Ka'Pa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on behalf of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Mara eventually gets ambushed by a crime boss named "Takara" (and yes he's named after a particular brand of sake) and hauled off to his dungeon.|Ryan Kaufman|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
Takara's stronghold was the setting of an entire level in [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOTS" /> Designer [[Donald Sielke]] created it and orchestrated Jade's confrontation with Takara's rancor.<ref name="Blog" />
